name: Domaine Pierre Usseglio & Fils Châteauneuf-du-Pape Réserve des Deux Frères 2015
text:
## Usseglio Réserve des Deux Frères 2015

**Story.** It is the same cuvée as wine 1, in a vintage of 100% Grenache, aged in 60% new and once-used barrels. See [Châteauneuf-du-Pape](https://www.google.com/maps?q=Chateauneuf-du-Pape,+France&t=k).

**Reviews.** Jeb Dunnuck's site lists the 2015 at 96+. He calls it backward and structured. I had earlier seen a 95–97 barrel range quoted second-hand, but his site does not show it. Jancis Robinson reviewed it, but the score sits behind her paywall. The three Delectable ratings for the 2015 look fine but are too few to mean much. CellarTracker community score, from your list: 95.7 (2015).

**Practical note.** Dunnuck suggested forgetting it for 4–5 years, then drinking over the following 15–20 years. That puts it in its window now. Decant for 1–2 hours and pair it with roast pork or lamb.

**Curious aside: oak.** The oak is relatively assertive for Châteauneuf. In the region, small barriques are not widely used, partly because Grenache oxidises easily, so this wine is a stylistic outlier.

### From the history books
- 2009: the AOC rules expand to 18 permitted varieties (see [Châteauneuf-du-Pape AOC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ch%C3%A2teauneuf-du-Pape_AOC)).
- 1376: Pope Gregory XI leaves Avignon on 13 September (see [Avignon Papacy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Avignon_Papacy)).
- 1948: Usseglio is founded (see [this search](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:Search?search=Ch%C3%A2teauneuf-du-Pape+wine+Usseglio&go=Go)).

**Sources:** Jeb Dunnuck (subscriber site, checked directly), Uncorked, Falstaff, Farr Vintners, J.J. Buckley, Vinfolio, FRW, First Bottle, Kysela, Benchmark Wine, K&L, Whwc, Thatchers, Winewithseth, CellarTracker, Delectable, closdesspiritueux.com, and Wikipedia ([Châteauneuf-du-Pape AOC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ch%C3%A2teauneuf-du-Pape_AOC), [Nahe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nahe_(wine_region)), [Vouvray AOC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vouvray_AOC), [La Clape](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Massif_de_la_Clape), [Avignon Papacy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Avignon_Papacy), [Great French Wine Blight](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Great_French_Wine_Blight)).
